title: Entropy Oracle
description: A crypto magic 8-ball with 24 original outcomes, three draw rules, entropy and histograms. Local randomness, original sound and a probability lesson.

title: Turing Garden
description: Paint a living Gray-Scott chemical garden. Explore four regimes and palettes, export artwork, and save the exact numerical state.

title: Chaos Mirrors
description: Two nearly identical double pendulums create diverging light trails. Explore deterministic chaos with presets, energy error and separation measurements.

title: Fourier Forge
description: Draw a shape, rebuild it with rotating harmonics, measure reconstruction error, and hear a waveform derived from the drawing.

title: Hash Cathedral
description: Turn text into SHA-256 geometric art. Flip one bit, inspect the avalanche, and build, tamper with and verify an eight-leaf Merkle proof.
